name: cobol-data-division-model-limits
body: parse_data_division consumes FD/SD headers without an AST node, checks PICTURE length as written (X(40) counts 5), attaches 66 to the outermost open record and 88 to the item before it, and stops a PICTURE at an unlisted clause word. Limit: file descriptions are not modelled and the clause list is heuristic. Upgrade when file-record facts need FD/SD nodes or a corpus shows a mis-absorbed clause.
